description: Machine-readable form of the AI input allowlist defined in docs/ai-input-allowlist.md. Concrete file paths only: no directories, no wildcards. A file is added only through a reviewed change to both this file and the table in docs/ai-input-allowlist.md.
location_note: Interim location. The final location is decided in the analyzer spec. The analyzer must take this list as explicit input and must not discover files by scanning directories.
